questions: Should the function normalize only numeric columns, leaving non-numeric columns unchanged, or should it raise an error or drop them?

Should the box plot be drawn for all columns (including non-numeric) or only for numeric columns after normalization?
What figure size or other matplotlib properties (e.g., grid, orientation) should be used for the box plot?
Should the function modify the input DataFrame in-place or return a new DataFrame?
How should the function handle columns with zero variance (all identical values after filling NaN)? Normalization could produce division by zero.
Is the box plot expected to be displayed (e.g., via plt.show()) or just the Axes object returned?
Should missing values be replaced by column's average before or after identifying numeric columns?
